sloka: नाश्वबन्धो ऽश्वमाजानान्न गजं कुञ्जरग्रह: ।मत्तप्रमत्तमुदिता नमू: सा तत्र सम्बभौ ॥ २.९१.५६॥
transliteration: nāśvabandho 'śvamājānānna gajaṁ kuñjaragraha: ।mattapramattamuditā namū: sā tatra sambabhau ॥ 2.91.56॥

translations.english: The attendants of draughtanimals fed the horses, elephants, donkeys, camels and oxen their appropriate food.
